Are you passionate about software development, engineering applications, and solving complex technical challenges? Join us as a Software Application Engineer and play a key role in developing innovative software solutions that make a real impact across the marine industry.
As a Software Application Engineer – Control Systems, you are responsible for developing new or adapting existing software for our control system contracts and development projects.
What you will be doing
The main task is the development and adaptation of control and automation application software for marine control systems. The software development is mainly done with function block programming in AutoCAD. Knowledge of C, Java and MATLAB Simulink is advantageous.
In this role you will work in close collaboration with project managers, application engineers, suppliers and our customers. Your main task will be to customize software according to individual customer requirements. In this role you will also provide technical support to our sales and service organization when necessary.
No matter if you're just starting out or have a few years of experience, we're here to help you grow. We are all about hands-on challenges and support to help you become the best Software Application Engineer you can be, right from the start of your career. We're all about fostering a creative, collaborative vibe where everyone can bring their ideas to the table.
We think you should have
To succeed in this position, you have a degree in engineering in the field of automation, electronics, data science, control theory or similar, and ideally previous experience in development and software design for automation systems. General experience of electrical design and marine operations is an advantage. Additional knowledge/experience in: AutoCad, C, Java, MATLAB Simulink and Linux is also advantageous. Due to the nature of our international customer and supplier base, a high level of both spoken and written English is necessary. Communication skills in other languages are advantageous.
At Kongsberg Maritime, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We encourage you to apply, even if you do not meet every requirement. Your unique perspective is valuable to us. Your skills, attitude and perspective could be exactly what we are looking for!
We review applications on an ongoing basis and may conduct interviews before the closing date, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Candidates progressing in the process may be invited to complete personality and aptitude assessments.
Kongsberg Maritime works with customers across both commercial and naval markets. As this role is subject to export control regulations, citizenship-related questions will be included in the recruitment process. Employment is conditional upon the successful completion of a pre-employment screening in accordance with company security standards.
Why join us
We offer flexible working hours and the option to work remote or from home office.
Start your career through development programs and mentorship from industry leaders.
Work on exciting projects that are shaping the future of the maritime industry.

Kongsberg Maritime is a global leader in maritime technology. We deliver advanced solutions to the merchant fleet, offshore, fishing, and naval vessels, setting new standards for safe, efficient, and sustainable operations - both for new builds and existing fleets. In close collaboration with customers and research environments, we develop technology that solves real challenges at sea. Today, more than 30,000 vessels operate with our systems on board. Kongsberg Maritime has more than 8,300 employees in 35 countries.
Our Propulsion and Handling division delivers world class products for propulsion, handling systems and waterjet for all marine industry sectors including merchant, offshore and naval. Our products enhance operational efficiency and deliver safe, secure, reliable and sustainable products to our valued customers.
Technologies for sustainable oceans

Mpya Sci & Tech was created by and for people who love technology and science. We’re not here to do what everyone else is doing. We believe that real talent lies in individuals who dare to keep growing throughout their entire lives. With extensive experience and deep industry knowledge, we’ve built a forward-leaning and cutting-edge company—our way. At Mpya Sci & Tech, we believe in a sustainable working life where we build a culture together based on genuine involvement, eager curiosity, and the freedom to be yourself. Learn more at: www.mpyascitech.com .
Would you like to develop and improve purification processes for complex proteins and help develop future medicines?
At Mpya Sci & Tech, we are looking for someone with solid experience in downstream process development and protein purification. You have a strong technical background, enjoy solving complex problems and like finding new solutions when existing methods are not enough.
As a consultant at Mpya Sci & Tech, you will have the opportunity to use your expertise in development projects at pharmaceutical and biotech companies. Your assignments may range from early-stage process development to optimization and scale-up ahead of manufacturing.
About the role
You will develop, optimize and troubleshoot purification processes for recombinant proteins and other biological molecules. This may involve developing new purification strategies, improving yield and product quality, or solving challenges related to aggregation, adsorption, instability and product loss.
Your work will include:
Developing and optimizing purification processes using chromatography and filtration.
Improving protein purity, stability, activity and yield.
Planning and evaluating experiments and analyzing results.
Troubleshooting processes and making them more robust, with future scale-up and GMP manufacturing in mind.

You will work closely with other specialists and contribute your expertise to developing reliable and practical process solutions.
Who are we looking for?
We are looking for someone with:
A relevant university degree in Life Science, preferably a PhD in biotechnology, biochemistry, chemical engineering or a related field.
Several years of experience in downstream process development and protein purification.
Hands-on experience with chromatography and filtration, such as ultrafiltration and diafiltration (UF/DF).
Experience working in a GMP-regulated environment within the development or manufacturing of biological medicines.
Experience working with CMOs/CDMOs in process development or manufacturing.
The ability to drive development work independently, analyze results and solve complex technical problems.
Excellent written and spoken in Swedish and English.

Experience in purifying challenging proteins and enzymes, scaling up processes and process validation is an advantage. Experience with regulatory documentation for biological medicines is also beneficial.
You are analytical, curious and solution-oriented. You enjoy solving technical challenges, take initiative and work well both independently and as part of a team.
How to apply
Interested in this role or curious about working as a consultant with us? Send us your application today! We interview candidates on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Application deadline: 23/11. If you have any questions, please contact Jasmin Khatibi  (jasmin.khatibi@mpyascitech.com, +46 76 163 63 00) or Johan Östman (johan.ostman@mpyascietch or +46 76 628 78 91)                                  .
Why Mpya Sci & Tech?
Mpya Sci & Tech was founded by people who love science and technology, for people who share that passion. Many of us have backgrounds in industry and consulting, so we know how important it is to find the right match, have support throughout your assignment and work for an employer who listens.
At Mpya, you can be yourself. Our office feels like a shared living room, and our culture is built on curiosity, openness and respect.
Read more at www.mpyascitech.com.
Does this sound like a role for you? We look forward to hearing from you!

Make It with Pride — Join Mondelēz International
At Mondelēz International, we empower people to snack right. We are one of the world's leading snack companies, home to iconic brands loved around the globe — including Milka, Oreo, Toblerone, and Marabou. Our purpose is to lead the future of snacking by offering the right snack, for the right moment, made the right way.
For our Upplands Väsby plant, home of Marabou, Daim, Oboy and pralines we are now looking for a Maintenance Engineer to join our Asset Reliability team and play a key role in driving equipment reliability, availability, and cost-effective maintenance across our site.
About the Role
As a Maintenance Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring equipment reliability and availability through strategic preventive and predictive maintenance, aligned with our IL6S (Integrated Lean 6 Sigma) strategy. Working closely with PM Planners, Maintenance Technicians, CI Engineers, Process Engineers, and the QA department, you will develop and improve our maintenance processes — with the ultimate goal of zero breakdowns and cost-efficient maintenance.
What You'll Do
Maintenance Strategy & Planning — Develop, implement, and optimize preventive and predictive maintenance plans. Lead the IL6S PM Pillar development and ensure strategy quality and compliance.
Reliability Analysis & RCA — Lead root cause analyses (RCA) and reliability studies to identify and eliminate recurring equipment failures. Conduct Life Cycle Cost (LCC) analyses and feed insights into the CAPEX roadmap.
Competence Development — Drive training and capability building within the maintenance team and among Line Technical Leads in preventive maintenance methodology, Progressive Maintenance (PM) methods, and SAP PM usage.
Continuous Improvement & Projects — Actively lead and participate in improvement projects, systematically eliminate operational disruptions, and contribute to the continuous development of the maintenance function.
Project Management — Drive maintenance-related projects and act as requirements owner in investment projects related to maintainability and maintenance safety.
Spare Parts Management — Optimize spare parts handling, ensure inventory accuracy, and drive efficient use of resources.
KPI Tracking & Analysis — Compile, analyze, and report maintenance KPIs including MTBB (Mean Time Between Breakdowns), equipment reliability, and % TBM/CBM completion.
Calibration Ownership — Own and continuously develop the calibration program in collaboration with the Quality department.
Cost Management — Analyze and follow up on maintenance costs — including the balance between reactive and preventive maintenance — to identify improvement opportunities and ensure cost efficiency.
Quality Assurance — Ensure all maintenance work meets quality requirements per GMP standards and owns the maintenance routines that describe how work is performed.

What You'll Bring
Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering (or equivalent experience)
Proven experience in maintenance engineering within a manufacturing environment, preferably FMCG
Strong knowledge of preventive and predictive maintenance strategies
Experience with root cause analysis (RCA) and reliability methodologies and Life Cycle Cost (LCC) analyses.
Familiarity with IL6S / TPM / World Class Manufacturing principles
Strong analytical skills and experience working with maintenance KPIs
Project management experience
Excellent communication and collaboration skills
Fluent in Swedish and English

What We Offer
A key role in Asset Reliability organization at a world-class manufacturing site
The opportunity to shape and drive the maintenance strategy with real impact on operational performance
A collaborative environment where you work closely with PM Planners, CI Engineers, Process Engineers, and QA
Development opportunities within Mondelēz International's global network
Competitive compensation and benefits package

Health & Benefits
﻿Friskvårdsbidrag (wellness allowance), on-site gym.
Food & Shopping
Subsidized lunch in our canteen and favorable discounts in our staff shop.
Easy Everyday Life
Fenced parking for all on-site employees and comprehensive employee support for health, work, and private life.
Security
Collective agreement and contractual insurance.
Community
Art association and social activities.
Work schedule: 100%

Strong position. Bigger ambitions. Want to be part of it?
🕐 Full-time

Sweden is our home market and where it all started – and we still see significant room to grow. With an established platform, a strong Nordic brand and an AI-powered product, there are new customers to win, deals to develop and market share to take.
We’re growing our sales team in Stockholm and are now looking for several commercially driven Account Managers with an entrepreneurial mindset who want to help take us further.
What will you do?
This is a new business role, and sales is your primary focus. You’ll be responsible for winning new customers in the Swedish market, from the first conversation to a signed deal. You’ll identify opportunities, open doors with decision-makers and build long-term customer relationships – primarily through online meetings.
This means proactive prospecting, meaningful business conversations and the ability to turn customer challenges into valuable solutions. You’ll work closely with colleagues across sales, marketing and customer success at our Stockholm HQ.
But we also want your ideas. Which customers should we be talking to? Where are the biggest opportunities? How can we improve the way we sell? You’ll have the opportunity to help shape the answers.
Who are we looking for?
We’re looking for someone with a proven track record of winning new B2B customers who enjoys owning the entire sales process.
We believe you:
Have strong business acumen. You understand your customers’ businesses, challenge their perspectives, and sell business value rather than product features.
Have drive and a winning mentality. You create your own opportunities, enjoy closing deals, and have the persistence to reach your goals.
Think entrepreneurially. You take initiative, find new ways forward, and are comfortable building and improving things along the way.
Build trust. You’re curious, a good listener, and confident engaging with senior decision-makers.
Take ownership. You work in a structured way, own your pipeline and results, learn from setbacks, and contribute to the team’s success.

You have experience in consultative B2B sales, preferably within SaaS or similar solutions, and are comfortable working with CRM systems. You’re fluent in Swedish and have good English communication skills.
About Mynewsdesk
We are the leading AI-powered PR and communications platform in Scandinavia and the DACH region. Since 2003, we have helped more than 15,000 organisations, from small businesses to established brands, create and distribute impactful PR content and measure its success. Around 80,000 pieces of content are published on our platform every year, which attracts 1.6 million visitors each month.
What do we offer?
You’ll have the opportunity to make a real impact in our home market, backed by an established SaaS platform, talented colleagues and an international organisation. We offer a competitive base salary, attractive performance-based compensation, and the opportunity to influence both your own results and how we grow our business in Sweden.
💡An innovative product with a clear vision and a strong purpose
🏙️ A modern office with an incredible view at Glashuset, Slussen, in central Stockholm
🤝 Close collaboration with sales, marketing and customer success colleagues at HQ
👶 Parental pay top-up to 90% of your salary for up to 90 days
🧘 SEK 5,000 wellness allowance per year + a weekly wellness hour
🏖️ 30 days of paid vacation
🛡️ Occupational pension
At Mynewsdesk, we value curiosity, initiative and collaboration. We believe in taking ownership, challenging the way things are done, and helping each other succeed.
Can you spot a business opportunity, build a relationship, and turn it into a great deal? Then we’d love to meet you.

Within the Applied Science group (AS, 18 people) of ILL's Science Division, you will act as instrument technician for the new ThRILL thermal neutron imaging instrument, which will enter user operation in 2027, and TENIS, an irradiation instrument serving academic and industrial needs.

Your tasks:
In this context, you will:
- Ensure the smooth operation and maintenance of ThRILL and TENIS, which are located in building ILL5, level C, at the reactor neutron source.

- Assist the ILL scientists responsible for ThRILL and TENIS with the preparation and conducting of experiments, typically together with scientific and industrial users.
- Propose technical improvements and, where appropriate, implement these improvements with the assistance of ILL services.
-Help to ensure compliance with ILL and instrument safety regulations, in particular radiation protection regulations.
-Become a valued member of the Applied Science group and support your colleagues and users where needed and appropriate.

 Job Overview
Role Summary
An experienced Workplace Technology Technical Lead is needed for a consulting assignment within a large organisation operating a complex IT environment. The role provides technical leadership for the digital workplace, Microsoft 365, client platforms and mobile devices. The assignment focuses on driving sustainable technical development and improvements that enhance productivity, user experience, stability and security.
You will work closely with business stakeholders, internal IT teams, suppliers and global IT functions. This is a technical leadership and advisory role with significant influence over technical direction, strategic choices and the long-term evolution of workplace technology. The role does not include day-to-day operations or operational delivery; instead, it complements existing suppliers and global governance functions without assuming their delivery, budget or resource responsibilities.
Key Responsibilities
Set and drive the technical direction for workplace technology, including developing, anchoring and following up a technical roadmap with dependencies, risks and agreed actions.
Identify improvement opportunities and recommend priorities to reduce technical debt and complexity while improving productivity, automation and user experience.
Lead technical analyses and risk assessments for investments and changes, producing recommendations and reviewing decision material based on business impact, security, supportability, cost and user value.
Define requirements for, challenge and follow up supplier and global IT team technical commitments, quality and documentation in collaboration with contract, service and delivery owners.
Represent business needs and the user perspective in CAB, Global CAB and other relevant decision-making forums.
Provide technical support during major incidents, problem investigations and complex changes, and recommend sustainable long-term corrective actions.
Contribute to technical documentation, knowledge transfer and internal capability development, working with ITSM stakeholders on lifecycle management.
Act as a technical advisor to internal IT functions and relevant service and decision owners.
Make technical decisions within defined frameworks and delegated authority, clearly communicating recommendations, risks, alternatives and required decision conditions.
Recommend additional analysis, conditions, postponement or escalation when decision material or risk management is insufficient.

Technical Stack & Requirements
Deep knowledge of Microsoft Intune, endpoint management, Windows client platforms and mobile device management.
Strong understanding of Microsoft 365 and the interaction between productivity, collaboration, endpoint and security capabilities.
Experience with technical governance, architecture principles, standardisation and lifecycle management.
Experience with established IT service management processes, including incident, problem and change management.
Knowledge of Microsoft 365 capabilities for security, collaboration and information management.
Experience with automation, analytics and proactive monitoring within the endpoint and digital workplace domain.
Exposure to licence optimisation, cost management, service follow-up, change management and user adoption.

Qualifications & Experience
The ideal candidate has several years of experience in technical leadership within digital workplace technology, client management or Microsoft 365 in a complex organisation. You should have experience of supplier governance, requirements management and follow-up of external and global deliveries, as well as the ability to translate business requirements into sustainable, secure and manageable technical solutions.
Experience from large, distributed or global organisations with substantial user populations and complex dependencies is required. A relevant Microsoft certification, or equivalent documented competence, is advantageous. The role requires an analytical and structured approach, the ability to prioritise complex dependencies and confidence in advising and guiding technical decisions without formal personnel responsibility.
Location
This is a consulting assignment for a large organisation with a complex and potentially global IT environment. Professional fluency in both Swedish and English, spoken and written, is required.
